messages:
marta: Tiny non-work dilemma  need a single movie + snack + 1-song combo to power me through refactor night. low effort, high comfort. recs?
jules: Movie: The Grand Budapest Hotel  Snack: salted almonds  Song: "Pillowtalk" (instrumental cover)  it's tidy and funny, nice pacing.
ryan: Movie: The Princess Bride  Snack: microwaved cinnamon apple slices  Song: "You Make My Dreams (cover)" for that optimistic boost.
may: Movie: Spirited Away (cozy nostalgia)  Snack: green tea + rice crackers  Song: a short piano loop of "Always With Me" helps me focus.
anika: Movie: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World (energy)  Snack: cheesy nachos  Song: any 3-min chiptune remix of the soundtrack. high BPM for bug stomping.
marta: Vote quick with emoji: 
   = Grand Budapest
   = Princess Bride
   = Spirited Away
   = Scott Pilgrim
  (use whatever emoji you want, I'll tally)
toaster-bot: playlist snippets created: https://open.spotify.fake/gbudapest-snack, https://open.spotify.fake/princess-snack, https://open.spotify.fake/spirited-snack, https://open.spotify.fake/pilgrim-snack (auto-link)
jules:  from me. tight color palette, easy to rewatch.
ryan:  here. singalong + comfort = sustainable morale.
may: . nostalgia helps me stop overthinking the diff.
anika:  for adrenaline. also gif of Scott doing a power punch.
marta: tally: Grand Budapest 1, Princess Bride 1, Spirited Away 1, Scott Pilgrim 1. tie — classic. tie-breaker: name the single track you'd add to the playlist that MUST play during the snack break.
jules: "Monsieur Gustave's Waltz" (or whatever is the quirky waltz)
ryan: "Inigo's Theme" (okay that's fabricated but close enough).
may: instrumental cover of "Always With Me" only.
anika: chiptune "We're Gonna Win" (imaginary but you get it).
marta: OK I'm doing a rotated 40-min set: each combo gets a 10-min highlight block tonight at 21:00 in the kitchen. I'll bring a bowl of cinnamon apples and a tiny speaker. if you want the Spotify snippet DM for the link. :headphones:
ryan: I'll bring napkins and a questionable playlist joke.
jules: Bringing extra almonds. labeling them "ethical almonds" so people feel fancy.
may: I'll bring a thermos of tea and my Spirited Away plush for moral support.
toaster-bot: event reminder posted for kitchen watch-and-snack 21:00 (auto-message).
marta: Thanks everyone  see you tonight, tiny pop-up cinema.
